name: Anomaly of Puberty or Menstrual Cycle of Genetic Origin

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Genetic Puberty and Menstrual Cycle Anomaly Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Absence or incomplete development of secondary sexual characteristics by age 14 in females or 15 in males
Primary or secondary amenorrhea or oligomenorrhea not explained by acquired causes
Identification of pathogenic variant(s) in genes known to regulate puberty or menstrual cycle
Abnormal gonadotropin or sex steroid hormone levels consistent with pubertal or menstrual dysfunction
Exclusion of acquired causes such as tumors, infections, or systemic diseases

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of delayed puberty and menstrual irregularity with genetic confirmation of causative mutation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of acquired causes and may be supported by hormonal profiling.

pathognomonic.notes: Failure to initiate menstruation by age 15
Low gonadotropin levels causing pubertal delay

common.notes: Late onset of pubic hair development
Difficulty conceiving due to hormonal or developmental abnormalities

occasional.notes: Reduced or absent sense of smell, especially in Kallmann syndrome variants
searchTerms: loss or reduced sense of smell

occasional.notes: Height below expected percentile for age
Generalized tiredness secondary to endocrine dysfunction

rare.notes: Cleft lip/palate or other craniofacial anomalies
Congenital heart defects associated with syndromic forms

laboratory: Low serum luteinizing hormone (LH) and follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH)
imaging: Delayed bone age on hand/wrist X-ray
MRI of hypothalamic-pituitary region to exclude structural lesions
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes such as KAL1, FGFR1, GNRHR, TAC3, or others involved in pubertal regulation
other: Olfactory testing for anosmia in suspected Kallmann syndrome
Pelvic ultrasound showing immature reproductive organs

redFlags: Absence of pubertal development by age 15
Severe hypogonadism with associated systemic symptoms
references: Orphanet: Anomaly of puberty or/and menstrual cycle of genetic origin - ORPHA:202940
